title: Jsonite Modded Resource pack example
description: Example Resource pack for Jsonite Mod library
body:
Example for the Jsonite mod, you MUST name the rescouce pack file "jsonite" for it to propperly register. This modded datapack just adds example a item, block and food. Primarily for showcase of the Jsonite Libary/Extension to datapacks. This datapack is not designed for actual usage and more of a way to show anyone using Jsonite for a mod how to use it with a real example.

Additions:

1. Example block: Easily broken block with nothing special. (uncraftable)
2. Example item: Example item with "epic" rarity class. (uncraftable)
3. Example food: example food on par with golden carrots. (uncraftable)
